name: Triple-confluence flush long (negative funding + extreme fear + realized-vol spike)
rationale: The strictest capitulation variant: three BOUNDED gauges must agree that a genuine flush is underway — funding has gone NEGATIVE (shorts paying), Fear&Greed is in extreme fear, AND realized volatility has SPIKED above a fitted level (the violent move that marks a true washout, not a slow grind). The thesis: a capitulation accompanied by a vol spike clears leverage fastest and bounces hardest; quiet fear without a vol event is just a sideways scare. All three are mean-reverting BOUNDED levels (vol_realized used with gt against a fitted spike level, not a drifting raw level). The triple-AND makes this the rarest, lowest-turnover spec in the family — fees negligible. Funding band sits on the negative side inside the clamp so it bites. DISCONFIRMER: the two-leg funding+fear sibling (no vol) is in this cohort — if the vol spike leg does not improve the deflated Sharpe, it is an over-fit third filter; conversely if only the vol-gated version passes, the result is a vol-mean-reversion artifact rather than the positioning+sentiment edge this niche is meant to test. DISCONFIRMER 2: three simultaneous extremes are very rare; too few trades is honest insufficient-evidence. Holdout must hold. Gate disposes.
catalyst: negative funding + extreme fear + realized-vol spike simultaneously
